🎗️ 𝐅𝐞𝐞𝐝𝐛𝐚𝐜𝐤 𝐟𝐫𝐨𝐦 𝐎𝐮𝐫 𝐋𝐨𝐫𝐝𝐬- 𝐍𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐦𝐛𝐞𝐫 𝟐𝟎𝟐𝟔 𝐔𝐩𝐝𝐚𝐭𝐞𝐬
🎗️

Lords, thank you for being such an awesome part of
our community!

Your feedback helps us keep improving Top Heroes.
Here are the latest optimizations and updates based
on feedback from our Lords:

🔧 𝐎𝐩𝐭𝐢𝐦𝐢𝐳𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬 & 𝐍𝐞𝐰 𝐅𝐞𝐚𝐭𝐮𝐫𝐞𝐬

🎗️ Optimized Universal Troop Skin exchange: Rare
and Epic Troop Skins can still be exchanged with
Universal Troop Skins after reaching max level.

🎗️ Added a feature to hide your UID. Lords can hide
their UID on the Profile page.

🎗️ Chat images now support Emoji replies.

🎗️ Added Milestone Rewards to Arms Clash.

🎗️ Added a Tutor shortcut to the Hearth Hall. Tap the
shortcut at the bottom to quickly select the
corresponding Tutor.

🎗️ Optimized settlement mail for weekly Ranked
Match rewards and season weekly rewards by adding
ranking details, so Lords can easily view their weekly
rankings.

🎗️ Optimized the Hearth Hall and added a setting to
switch Chat between half-screen and full-screen
modes.

🎗️ Added a filter for Your Server’s Carriages. Enable
it on the Carriage screen to hide Carriages from Your
Server. This filter only applies to the Carriage screen.

🎗️ Optimized the Carriage interface. Carriages that
have reached the plunder limit will no longer be
shown.

🎗️ Added Guild Mail notifications. When enabled in
Notifications, Lords will receive a phone notification
whenever guild management sends a new Guild Mail.

🎗️ During the Royal Castle contest in Windrest City,
you will receive 1 free relocation attempt every 5
minutes. Free relocation attempts do not stack. When
you have a free relocation attempt, relocating your
Territory to a designated location will not consume
any items.

🎗️ Adjusted the position of Cordelia’s skill on the
Bounty screen. The skill icon will now be hidden after
use.

🎗️ Extended the Trade Store duration in Limited
Events. After the event ends, it will stay in Super Deal
for 3 more days, and rewards can still be redeemed.

Thank you again for sharing your thoughts and
suggestions with us. Please keep the feedback
coming! 💬

the Official Gold Blocks Website
